english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the way someone performs or does something.
Use 做法 as the all-purpose colloquial word for a particular way of doing something.
Use this for the particular way a person or organization does something.
Use this for the manner or way in which something is done.
Use this for the particular approach or way of doing or organizing something, rather than a formal system.
Use this for the prescribed way or procedure for carrying out a particular operation.
Use this for a custom or practice, or for someone's usual way of doing things, rather than for a physical object.
